content.text: {"heavy-calm":"Stillness is far from this crouching black cat, so let it be a gentle jolt. Those green eyes keep watch while you stay quiet and inward.","mid-calm":"The wide cream ground offers some rest, but the raised tail and bared teeth keep a small spark alive in your unhurried day.","bright-calm":"Warm cream paper and red letters carry a mild cheer, though the cat itself is all coiled readiness. It brings a playful edge to your gentle mood.","heavy-mid":"The heavy black body, flat and solid as cut paper, has weight to match your thoughts, while the snarl adds a flicker of defiance.","mid-mid":"Clear red lettering, one black animal, plenty of open space. The design is steady and plain, with just enough prowl in the low crouch to enliven an ordinary day.","bright-mid":"There is humor in those oversized white claws and the curling tail, a fierce face drawn with a wink. Your easy, hopeful mood will find a friend here.","heavy-charged":"Your tension has a mirror in the open red mouth and narrowed green eyes, a body lowered just before a spring. The storm stays bold but contained.","mid-charged":"Every line of this panther is mid-pounce, a front paw reaching out past the lettering. It shares your restless, alert charge and gives it a shape.","bright-charged":"Bold red block letters shout across the cream like a circus banner, and the cat's lunge carries that thrill. Its joy has teeth, which suits exuberance."}

{"heavy-calm":"The black wall of silhouetted onlookers gives your stillness a quiet place to rest, though the dancer's kick beyond them pulls the other way. Treat it as a window, not a mirror.","mid-calm":"The pale yellow ground glows like warm lamplight and suits an unhurried mood. The whirl of white skirts at the center is livelier than you are, a gentle nudge.","bright-calm":"The soft yellow of floor and sky shares your warmth, even if the high-kicking dancer brings more motion than rest. Think of it as warmth with its sleeves rolled up.","heavy-mid":"The grey man in the foreground, shadowed under his top hat, carries some of your gravity, while the bright dancer behind him offers a lighter thought to weigh against it.","mid-mid":"An ordinary night out turns into steady rhythm: slanting floorboards, a row of top hats, a dancer mid-step. Crowd and soloist balance each other the way a good evening does.","bright-mid":"That red polka-dot blouse and the frothy white skirts carry the easy cheer you're feeling, a dancer plainly enjoying herself and asking no one's permission.","heavy-charged":"Your tension gets a release valve in that flung-up leg and the stark black crowd. The drama here runs playful rather than stormy, energy spent on the dance floor.","mid-charged":"Restless energy is the whole point: the dancer's leg flicks up, the floorboards rush toward you, and the red lettering stacks itself three times as if it couldn't sit still.","bright-charged":"Joy at full volume. The white petticoats burst open like a firework against the black crowd, and the bold red letters seem to shout right along with you."}

{"heavy-calm":"The shadowed ground at the bottom edge holds some of your quiet, and the two figures standing still at the fence offer a soft place to rest your eyes.","mid-calm":"Two travelers pause at a white picket fence, in no rush, just looking. Their unhurried stance matches an even, restful mood like yours.","bright-calm":"Notice the joined hands of the two astronauts. That small, tender gesture under a pale mint sky carries the gentle warmth you are feeling now.","heavy-mid":"For a grave, thoughtful frame of mind, the vast red canopy offers weight, while the pointing figure turns that heaviness toward wonder rather than worry.","mid-mid":"A familiar picket fence set on a strange world: Kepler-186f balances the ordinary and the unknown, much like a steady, everyday mood that still notices things.","bright-mid":"Hopeful moods like company. Here two figures hold hands and gaze toward glowing red trees, as if an easy new home were just over the fence.","heavy-charged":"The storm in you may find relief in this bright red forest. Its blaze has energy to match yours but trades tension for curiosity and play.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs through the jagged red foliage, and one astronaut's outstretched arm points ahead. This poster shares your urge to go see what is next.","bright-charged":"Fiery reds, curly golden lettering and a pair of explorers on an adventure together. Kepler-186f is as playful and lively as the joy you brought in."}

{"heavy-calm":"For a quiet, inward mood, the deep navy that fills most of this sheet offers a hush to rest in, though the slanting yellow beams keep a low hum of suspense nearby.","mid-calm":"The lamp hangs perfectly still on its short chain, a steady center above all the lettering. You can let your eye settle there while the rest of the poster buzzes softly around it.","bright-calm":"Warm mustard yellow pours down from a single lamp onto dark blue, like a porch light at night. It carries more theatrical tension than rest, but the glow itself is gentle.","heavy-mid":"A lone light hanging over darkness has a grave, interrogation-room feel, and that cone of yellow gives your weighty thoughts a shape, sharpened by a wink of mischief in the jaunty type.","mid-mid":"Here is an everyday object, a plain dome lamp, turned into a little stage. The balance of navy and yellow, top and bottom, feels as steady as a well-run evening at the theater.","bright-mid":"Hope often looks like this: a beam of warm yellow opening up a dark space. The cheerful hand-drawn letters riding the light keep the mood easy and a bit playful.","heavy-charged":"Stormy feelings find a match in the hard spotlight cutting through deep night blue. The tension is real here, yet the bouncing, tilted lettering hints that the drama comes with a grin.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs right up the two slanted beams, where the letters lean and jostle as if eager to get going. The poster feels like the moment before a curtain rises.","bright-charged":"The swooping white script at the center has a showman's flourish, and against the bold yellow and dark blue it lands like applause. Lively, a little sly, and ready for a night out."}

{"heavy-calm":"Little here is quiet; the red ground hums from edge to edge. If you carry something heavy, the small rover rolling at left offers a gentle nudge to keep exploring.","mid-calm":"Your unhurried mood can rest on the cream sphere at center, the one large still shape among the zigzags, while the rest of the poster buzzes politely around it.","bright-calm":"The yellow and purple wheat stalks at lower right share your warmth, though the poster runs louder than you. Let it brighten a quiet wall rather than hush it.","heavy-mid":"For a grave, thoughtful mood, the cracked cream sphere offers a foothold, but mostly this lifts weight away, turning a distant red world into somewhere you might visit.","mid-mid":"Steady days can use a spark. Neatly stacked shapes, a yellow tower, a ladder, a falling drop, bring order to all that red, so the energy stays easy to live with.","bright-mid":"Hope runs through the design, from the bold yellow letters spelling Mars to the sprouting grain, picturing a far planet as a place with towns, crops and welcome.","heavy-charged":"Your storm meets a different kind of charge. The black zigzags crackle like lightning, yet the hot reds and yellows steer that tension toward play instead of dread.","mid-charged":"Restless energy has room to roam: a rover on the move, a rocket darting past, circles and zigzags everywhere. Your eye can keep moving and never run out.","bright-charged":"Exuberance in flat, saturated color. The blazing red field and the bullseye of purple, blue and yellow at center share your joy and your appetite for adventure."}

{"heavy-calm":"The large empty frame at the center holds nothing but pale cream paper. If you feel quiet and inward, that blank space leaves room for you to sit with your thoughts.","mid-calm":"Navy lettering on warm cream, laid out in an even, measured column. Nothing hurries here, and the steady rhythm of the type matches an unhurried day.","bright-calm":"Thin red lines trace the stepped panels like soft edges of light. It is a gentle, warm design that rests easily on the eye, much as you are resting now.","heavy-mid":"When your thoughts feel weighty, the tall, upright capitals of the word dance stand like columns. They give a grave mood something steady and orderly to lean against.","mid-mid":"Balanced from top to bottom, with small boxes anchoring each lower corner, this poster has an everyday steadiness. It is a calm piece of practical design.","bright-mid":"The looping script reading festival of curls with a little playfulness between the sturdier letters. That easy flourish matches the hopeful lift you are feeling.","heavy-charged":"For a stormy mood, the fanned navy and red panels offer a quiet stage instead of more drama. Their crisp, stacked edges can help a tense mind settle back into order.","mid-charged":"Restless energy can find a pause here. The stepped panels behind the frame seem ready to open like wings, holding motion in check before a performance begins.","bright-charged":"Joy here comes in a small, sly form: tiny dark balls sit at the frame's corners like feet, as if the whole shape might start dancing along with you."}

{"heavy-calm":"The grey, clouded sky over this tiger keeps everything hushed. Its stillness is watchful rather than sleepy, a quiet you can sit inside without being asked to brighten.","mid-calm":"Stretched full length across dry, olive ground, the tiger rests without hurry. Its long body and loose tail share your unhurried, even pace.","bright-calm":"Warm amber fur catches what light there is, glowing against the dull earth. Here is rest with real warmth in it, gentle on the eye though the animal stays alert.","heavy-mid":"Look at the tiger's steady gaze, level and unblinking under heavy brows. It carries weight and thought, a grave presence held perfectly in check.","mid-mid":"Paws crossed, head raised, the tiger simply waits on open ground. That balanced pose, neither sleeping nor stirring, matches a steady, ordinary day.","bright-mid":"The soft orange coat and creamy chest give this resting cat an easy warmth. You can enjoy its calm confidence, a kind of hope that nothing needs rushing.","heavy-charged":"Beneath the brooding sky, this tiger holds its power in reserve. It answers a stormy mood with coiled tension rather than release, strength that has chosen to lie still.","mid-charged":"Those dark claws and alert ears show energy only paused. If you feel restless, the tiger offers a way to hold that charge calmly, ready but unspent.","bright-charged":"Exuberance finds a quieter partner here. The tiger's bold black stripes keep a lively rhythm, but its repose asks your joy to slow down and look a while."}

{"heavy-calm":"The lone dark figure halfway down the hall walks without hurry, small against the repeating arches. It keeps you company in quiet, the way an empty corridor holds an afternoon.","mid-calm":"Arch after arch steps back toward a pale doorway at the far end, an even rhythm your eye can follow slowly, one opening at a time.","bright-calm":"Warm ochre walls and rust floors glow here like late sun, though the long hall carries some unease. Rest in the yellow and let the distance stay distant.","heavy-mid":"Van Gogh painted this passage while living there, and the thick outlines on each arch press inward. The weight you carry meets a hall that holds its own grave patience.","mid-mid":"An ordinary hallway, painted with care: tiled floor, pillars, a green strip across the ground. It shows how steady attention can make plain days hold together.","bright-mid":"Look past the shadows to the small bright opening at the corridor's end. Hope here is modest and real, a lit doorway you can keep walking toward.","heavy-charged":"The arches tighten as they recede, their violet edges pulling you down a narrowing tunnel. That squeeze matches tension honestly, then offers the far light as release.","mid-charged":"Every surface hums with quick, restless brushstrokes, the ceiling scratched with ochre lines. Your energy finds a channel here, gathered and sent forward down one long hall.","bright-charged":"Joy runs louder than this quiet passage, yet the brick reds and flashes of turquoise on the walls carry heat. Let them keep your spark while the corridor slows you."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you feel low and quiet, the thin curl of smoke rising from the cigar in its brass dish offers a small stillness, while the kitten's play stays gentle rather than loud.","mid-calm":"The polished table holds soft reflections of each domino, and the kitten moves slowly among them. It is an unhurried scene, attention given fully to one small thing.","bright-calm":"Warm light falls across the kitten's white fur as it crouches over a single domino. The mood is light and at rest, mischief kept soft and tender.","heavy-mid":"Against the dark green curtain and heavy stone column, a kitten pats at scattered dominoes. When things feel weighty, it offers a reminder that small, curious play still goes on.","mid-mid":"A pencil, a crumpled paper, a game left mid-play: ordinary objects on an ordinary table, made lively by one alert kitten. It matches a steady, everyday frame of mind.","bright-mid":"You can almost see the next pounce in the kitten's lowered head and tensed paw on the domino. It carries the easy, hopeful warmth you are feeling.","heavy-charged":"Stormy feelings may find relief here. The kitten's stalk across the toppled dominoes is all tension released as play, a light counterweight to something heavier.","mid-charged":"The raised black tail and fixed gaze hold restless energy ready to spring. It shares your alertness, though here it is channeled into a game.","bright-charged":"Dominoes scattered everywhere and a kitten mid-pounce, tail high: this is joy at small scale. It meets your lively mood with a quieter, tender kind of delight."}

{"heavy-calm":"Quiet is hard to find near the orange lightning bolt, but the small seated child, absorbed in his toy, gives you a still center to rest your eyes on.","mid-calm":"For an unhurried mood, look past the jagged bolt to the soft, mottled blue behind it, printed like weathered cloth, which slows the whole sheet down.","bright-calm":"The warmth here is protective rather than gentle: a blue disc catches the orange strike so the little figure below can keep playing, unbothered.","heavy-mid":"Behind the flat, cheerful colors sits a grave public warning. The sharp orange zigzag aimed at a child carries real weight, the kind you can think about rather than flinch from.","mid-mid":"Steady as a notice on a clinic wall, the stacked block lettering in orange, blue and brown does plain, everyday work, line by line, with no wasted motion.","bright-mid":"Hope arrives as a shield. The tilted blue disc breaks the lightning apart in a spray of short lines, a small victory drawn with real confidence.","heavy-charged":"Your stormy mood meets its match in the orange bolt slamming down from the upper left, its jagged point colliding with a blue disc in a burst of sharp strokes.","mid-charged":"All that restless energy has somewhere to go: speed lines trail the blue disc as it flies in to intercept the strike, a poster built on motion and alarm.","bright-charged":"The joy here is defiant rather than carefree. Hot orange and clear blue clash on cream paper, and the danger is stopped mid-air while the boy plays on."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you want stillness, look past the crest to Mount Fuji, small and snow-capped in the trough. Here quiet sits inside the storm, steady while everything else heaves.","mid-calm":"The pale, flat sky behind the wave gives your eye an even place to rest, though the water never settles. It is calm watching something restless.","bright-calm":"Gentleness here lives in the scattered dots of spray drifting like snow across the warm beige sky. A small softness to hold onto in a charged scene.","heavy-mid":"The rowers bow low in their long boats, heads down beneath the curling crest. That posture of bracing and enduring carries the weight you are sitting with.","mid-mid":"Steadiness comes from the balance of the design: the great wave on the left, the peak on the right, deep blue and cream weighed evenly across the sheet.","bright-mid":"Hope runs quieter here than the storm, but it holds: the boats still ride the swell, and the distant mountain stays clear, white and patient beyond the water.","heavy-charged":"The foam breaks into clawing fingers that reach over the boats. It holds your tension exactly, that suspended moment before the fall, drawn in deep blue.","mid-charged":"Every line is moving: the swell rising, the boats sliding, the spray flying loose. Your restlessness has company in a sea that refuses to keep one shape.","bright-charged":"Joy is not the wave's own feeling, yet its energy can carry yours. Follow the leaping curl of white foam and let all that motion lift you."}

{"heavy-calm":"Against your stillness, this is a bright interruption: a gloved hand lifting an orange sunburst card from the dark. It won't match your quiet, but it may gently pull you outward.","mid-calm":"The deep black around these scattered souvenir cards gives the eye somewhere to rest. The colors are loud, yet the slow drift of the starry window above keeps a patient pace.","bright-calm":"The pale green card with its soft white star glows quietly among louder neighbors. Its gentle light suits your warmth, though the rest of the poster hums livelier than rest.","heavy-mid":"Beneath the play sits something weighty: a lone hand reaching into the dark of space, holding proof of a distant world. The cheer here offers relief from your gravity.","mid-mid":"Like a desk of keepsakes after a trip, these cards lie overlapping in easy disorder. 51 Pegasi b feels everyday here, as ordinary and fond as a postcard from home.","bright-mid":"Hope runs through the orange rays bursting behind 51 Pegasi b, like sunrise on a holiday card. Its warmth and its fond, old-fashioned travel feel match your easy mood.","heavy-charged":"Your storm finds a release valve in the tall cream-and-red lettering at the bottom, bold and stamped like a headline. It turns tension into forward motion and lightness.","mid-charged":"Restless energy spills across these tilted, overlapping cards, each angled as if just tossed down. The tiny figure leaping across a yellow sun shares your urge to go somewhere.","bright-charged":"Joy explodes from the orange sunburst, stars scattered like confetti across it. With its jaunty retro lettering and vacation-bright colors, this poster celebrates as freely as you feel."}

{"heavy-calm":"One thin thread of smoke climbs from a resting cigarette into the dark. That small, still line holds a quiet heaviness, though the sky above it is already stirring.","mid-calm":"For an unhurried mood, this poster asks more than it rests. Its broad silhouette of black treeline is steady ground, but the orange glow behind it keeps you watchful.","bright-calm":"Where you feel light and at ease, this offers a sober counterpoint: a soft pale grey sky turning to ember orange, a reminder of what gentle days can lose.","heavy-mid":"The weight here sits in the black silhouette of the forest, filling half the sheet beneath billowing smoke. It carries grave thought about small acts and large consequences.","mid-mid":"Clear and plainly built, the design moves your eye from cigarette to treeline to sky in one steady path. Its calm order sits on top of real alarm.","bright-mid":"Hopeful moods can find a warning worth keeping here. The warm orange haze glows almost like sunrise, yet it is smoke, a plea to protect what is good.","heavy-charged":"Your stormy mood meets its match in clouds rolling in heavy layers of grey and teal over a burning orange band, the forest already black beneath.","mid-charged":"Restless energy runs through the rough, splintered orange lettering, carved like burnt wood. Every edge feels alert, as if the warning itself were crackling.","bright-charged":"Joy finds a sharp contrast here rather than company. The bold orange and the bright white cigarette pop with lively energy, but they announce danger, a jolt toward care."}

{"heavy-calm":"Unlit lamps and spent candle stubs crowd a dim shelf, each one holding its quiet. The darkness behind them settles in alongside you rather than pushing it away.","mid-calm":"Nothing on this shelf is in a hurry. Brass candlesticks and tin lanterns sit where they were left, glowing faintly against deep green shadow, content to wait.","bright-calm":"A single pale candle catches the light at the top of a lantern, small and warm. Amid so much shadow, it offers you a gentle point of rest.","heavy-mid":"John Frederick Peto gathers worn lamps from years gone by, dented and tilted, as if weighing what lasts. It suits a mind turning over something serious.","mid-mid":"A plain wooden shelf on two brackets holds an ordinary clutter of household lights. Steady and unshowy, it honors everyday objects for simply having been used.","bright-mid":"Dull gold brass glints here and there through the gloom, like small kept memories. The warmth is muted, but it is there, and it holds steady for you.","heavy-charged":"The stormy feeling finds no echo in this still shelf. Instead, its dark hush and unlit wicks offer a place to set the tension down for a while.","mid-charged":"When you feel restless, the slow work of looking helps: a tipped candlestick, a hanging tin box, a curl of paper. Each detail asks you to slow down.","bright-charged":"Your joy runs louder than this dim, wistful shelf. Its one bright candle can be a quiet companion, a reminder of how light carries over the years."}

{"heavy-calm":"Under that heavy olive sky, a small figure walks alone toward the thatched cottage. The dim road and dark water at the edge hold the same quiet inwardness you carry.","mid-calm":"Look at the patch of sunlit road near the cottage, a pale clearing in a shadowed field. It gives you a slow, unhurried place to rest your eye while the clouds gather.","bright-calm":"Your lightness finds a foothold in the creamy clouds breaking over the trees. Around them the mood is darker, so this one offers warmth as a brief opening rather than a full embrace.","heavy-mid":"The great oak stands dense and dark against a churning sky, solid and patient. Its weight matches a thoughtful, grave frame of mind without tipping into despair.","mid-mid":"A lone walker on an ordinary country road, a cottage, a tree, a coming storm. Dupré makes everyday life steady even under brooding weather, much as your own day holds.","bright-mid":"Hope here lives in the gleam on the path and the blue showing through the clouds. The painting leans somber, but those gaps of light meet your warmth halfway.","heavy-charged":"Thick, restless brushwork piles the clouds into a looming mass above the road. That gathering tension before rain mirrors the storm you feel, held just before it breaks.","mid-charged":"Notice how wind seems to bend the small tree beside the cottage while clouds roll in. Your alert, restless energy has company in that charged, waiting air.","bright-charged":"Exuberance finds little echo in these dark greens and browns. Instead the bright cloud edges, lit like foam, offer you a calmer counterweight, a moment of awe to steady the rush."}

{"heavy-calm":"The pale haze where sea meets sky asks nothing of you. It offers a quiet place to rest a heavy mood, soft enough to sit beside without pushing it away.","mid-calm":"Tiny dots of sand, lilac and green build a field that breathes slowly. Toorop paints an unhurried morning, matching your restful, even pace stroke for stroke.","bright-calm":"Warm sandy gold under a milky blue sky, with a small dog crossing the green foreground. Light, gentle and at rest, it shares your mood closely.","heavy-mid":"Curving wheel tracks cross the field toward a distant cart, marks of work already done. For a weighty, thoughtful mind, they suggest patience and the quiet passing of time.","mid-mid":"A figure at the shore, a cart on the horizon, a dog in the grass: ordinary life spread across a wide, steady field. Balanced and everyday, much like you.","bright-mid":"Soft violet shadows warm into gold across the sand, and the mist lifts toward pale blue. A hopeful, easy calm sits in that gentle glow.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, this misty shore offers relief rather than echo. The flat, wide horizon and hushed surf can steady a tense mind and lower the volume.","mid-charged":"Your restless energy might find a channel in the looping tracks that swirl across the sand, though the scene itself stays still. It can slow you down gently.","bright-charged":"The bounding dog in the grass carries a small spark of play, but the hazy sea keeps things quiet. It holds your joy softly, like a pause after laughter."}

{"heavy-calm":"The irises droop over the white jug's lip, some heads bowed low toward the table. That quiet sag can keep your stillness company while the blue gently lifts the room.","mid-calm":"A pale, softly brushed wall lets the flowers rest without crowding. You can look slowly here, letting your eye drift from one blue petal to the next.","bright-calm":"Cool blue blooms against a cream background feel like a window opened on a mild morning. The gentleness you carry is already in these tender petals.","heavy-mid":"Look at the one withered bloom, browned at the upper right, among the fresh ones. Van Gogh lets fading sit beside fullness, something worth turning over slowly.","mid-mid":"A jug of flowers on a green tabletop: an ordinary sight, made steady by the plain horizontal band that grounds the whole arrangement.","bright-mid":"The spray of irises opens wide, leaves fanning out like reaching hands. It carries the easy hope you feel, warm without needing to shout.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood churns, these thick, twisting strokes of blue offer a place to set it down, energy channeled into petals rather than storm.","mid-charged":"Every leaf here is a quick, sharp stroke pointing somewhere new. Your restlessness finds a match in that motion, held together by the sturdy white jug.","bright-charged":"Blossoms burst past the edges of the frame, too many to contain in one vase. That overflowing blue gives your exuberance a cooler, lasting echo."}

{"heavy-calm":"The winged figure rests her cheek on her fist, eyes open in shadow, completely still. If you are sitting quietly with something heavy, she keeps you company without asking anything.","mid-calm":"Beside her, a thin dog sleeps curled on the floor, the one creature here fully at peace. Let your eye settle there; the rest of the crowded room can wait.","bright-calm":"A rainbow arcs over a far, flat sea in the upper corner. The feeling here runs darker than yours, but that small band of light offers a gentle place to rest.","heavy-mid":"Scales, an hourglass and a bell hang above her head, measuring things she no longer reaches for. It is a picture made for weighing hard questions slowly, as you are now.","mid-mid":"Look at the tools dropped on the floor: a saw, a plane, scattered nails, all set down mid-task. Ordinary work paused by thought sits close to a steady, everyday frame of mind.","bright-mid":"Hope runs low in this room, yet the small winged child beside her keeps scribbling on a tablet. Follow that busy little hand; it carries something of your easier mood.","heavy-charged":"A comet blazes across the sky, a bat-winged creature unfurls a banner, and the great stone block leans at an uneasy angle. Beneath her stillness hums the tension you feel.","mid-charged":"Every surface is crowded with fine engraved lines: compasses, keys, a ladder climbing out of frame. Your restless energy will find plenty to chase, even as the figure herself refuses to move.","bright-charged":"Your joy and this brooding figure sit far apart. Still, the rays bursting over the water carry a spark like yours, a bright flare burning inside a heavy, quiet room."}

{"heavy-calm":"The dark arch under the bridge sits over frozen water going nowhere. If you feel quiet and inward, this snowbound corner of Amsterdam keeps you company without asking anything.","mid-calm":"Nothing hurries in this winter morning. A thin thread of chimney smoke drifts into the hazy sky, as unhurried as your own pace.","bright-calm":"The feeling here runs a shade cooler than yours, but the red tiled roof under fresh snow carries a small warmth you will recognize, a hearth inside the cold.","heavy-mid":"Weight sits in the long brick bridge and the heavy curve of its arch, solid against soft fog. It suits a thoughtful frame of mind, sturdy enough to lean on.","mid-mid":"Two small figures stand by the gate as a horse and cart cross above, ordinary errands on an ordinary cold day. Steady and everyday, much like you feel.","bright-mid":"Hope here is quiet: an amber glow warming the clouds around the distant pale tower. It meets your easy mood gently, softening it rather than lifting it higher.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood churns, this scene sets everything on ice. The frozen canal and hushed fog offer a place to lower the storm, not a mirror for it.","mid-charged":"Restless energy finds little to push against here, and that may be the point. Let your eye settle on the streaked gray ice and slow down with it.","bright-charged":"Van Troostwijk painted a hush, so your high spirits will find a counterweight here. Still, the snow piled bright along the bridge has a crisp sparkle worth pausing for."}

{"heavy-calm":"If you feel low and still, the two skiers offer a gentle way out: a quiet white slope, steady strides, and nothing asked of you but to follow along.","mid-calm":"The pale blue sky and wide white hill keep things unhurried. The two figures climb in matching rhythm, poles planted, at an easy pace.","bright-calm":"Warm rust scarves against cold snow give this a cozy lightness. It feels like a good winter afternoon: bright air and someone beside you.","heavy-mid":"For a grave mood, these climbers are a counterweight: shoulders forward, poles dug in, working uphill together. Weight becomes shared effort here, left behind on the slope.","mid-mid":"Two figures, one stride, matching blue suits. They move in step with an everyday steadiness, like a routine walk made festive by snow.","bright-mid":"Hopeful and easy, much like you. Small puffs of snow kick up at each boot, and the striped mittens add a playful note to the climb.","heavy-charged":"When things feel stormy, this turns that energy into something clean: bold diagonal poles, flat shapes, and a clear blue sky with no weather brewing at all.","mid-charged":"Restless energy needs somewhere to go, and here it goes uphill. The skiers lean hard into the slope, snow spraying, every line pushing forward.","bright-charged":"Joy in motion. One skier's white hair streams back in the wind, and the tall blue and rust capitals below declare a love of winter with total confidence."}

{"heavy-calm":"Deep purple shadows fill the lower gorges with real stillness. They keep company with an inward mood, while pink light above stops the weight from closing in.","mid-calm":"Flat bands of pink and lavender step down the mesas at an even pace, like slow breathing. Nothing here hurries, not even the thin pale river far below.","bright-calm":"Soft pink clouds drift over warm rose cliffs, and the whole canyon is washed in gentle light. It shares your ease: a vast place, resting.","heavy-mid":"The canyon's scale carries real gravity, its dark navy depths cut deep beneath the sunlit ridges. It gives a weighty mind something old and patient to think beside.","mid-mid":"Clean, steady capital letters anchor the pink band at the bottom, beside a small bison emblem. Above them the view opens wide, grounded and plainly made.","bright-mid":"Orange edges catch the sun along every ledge, warm and easy on the eye. Made as an open welcome, it carries the hopeful feel of a trip still ahead.","heavy-charged":"Where your mood runs stormy, this canyon answers with calm. Its sharp dark cliffs hint at drama, but the slow pink sky lets the tension settle.","mid-charged":"For restless energy, the jagged ridges give the eye plenty to climb, ledge by ledge. Then the quiet river at the bottom offers a place to land.","bright-charged":"Your exuberance will find a quieter partner here. The bright pink cliffs share your brightness, though they glow slowly rather than dance, a pause inside the joy."}

{"heavy-calm":"When you feel low and quiet, the soft sky blue here asks very little. A small figure shelters under a white umbrella, a gentle reminder that cover can be found.","mid-calm":"The wide, even blue and the slow wobble of the yellow book outline keep a restful pace. Nothing here hurries you.","bright-calm":"Soft blue, a pale umbrella, a warm touch of yellow: this poster shares your lightness, small and kind, like a rainy afternoon spent reading indoors.","heavy-mid":"Weighty thoughts can use a lighter companion. The tall, thin black letters stand firm, but the little reader perched on a book keeps the gravity from settling too deep.","mid-mid":"Steady and everyday, this is ordinary care made charming: one figure, one umbrella, one book, set against plain blue with a single yellow dot for punctuation.","bright-mid":"The hopeful ease you feel is right here in the figure's upturned eye and sunny yellow sleeves, sheltering a book as if it were an old friend.","heavy-charged":"For a stormy mood, here is weather already tamed.
